newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Super Coffeemix signs venture for plant.
newsitem.headline: Super Coffeemix signs venture for plant.

text.p: Super Coffee Manufacturing Ltd said on Friday it signed a joint venture agreement with Continental Coffee Ltd (Continental) and Singcafe Partners (Singcafe) to make instant coffee.
Continental is incorporated in India and Singcafe is a limited partnership in Delaware, U.S.A.

Under the terms of the agreement, the parties will subscribe for shares of Singapore $1.00 par value each in the capital of Super Continental Pte Ltd, a company incorporated in Singapore for the purpose of the joint venture.
Super Coffeemix said in a statment the joint venture would set up a plant in Singapore to make soluble coffee for sale in Singapore and abroad.
The parties will subscribe for the initial capital of the agreement at par and for cash, it said.
Super Coffee Manufacturing will subscribe for 8.1 million shares, Continental for 2.0 million shares and Singcafe for 1.125 million shares.
They will subscribe for their shareholding on or before April 15.

The transaction is not expected to have any significant effect on the earnings and net tangible asset values of Super Coffee Manufacturing for the financial year ending December 31, 1997, the statement said.
